settings.name: Maya R.
settings.title: I finally stopped forgetting
settings.quote: The same bottle of vitamins sat in my locker for a year. A pouch at the start of every shift is something I actually do. Blueberry Peach tastes like dessert, not medicine.

settings.name: Daniel K.
settings.title: No more powder at security
settings.quote: I used to get pulled aside for my tub of greens powder. Seven pouches fit in my carry-on, and there's no shaker to rinse in a hotel sink.

settings.name: Sophie L.
settings.title: Ten seconds, honestly
settings.quote: I timed it for my video: twist, squeeze, done before the 7:40 train pulled in. It's the only part of my morning that's never late.

settings.name: Jordan T.
settings.title: Lives in my gym bag
settings.quote: No fridge, no water, no scoop. I hand them to clients who skipped breakfast, and Grape Raspberry is the one everyone asks for again.

settings.name: Priya S.
settings.title: Tart in the best way
settings.quote: Green Apple Lime wakes me up better than a second coffee. One star off only because I want a bigger box for exam season.

settings.name: Marcus W.
settings.title: Ranked all five on camera
settings.quote: Did the Discovery Box ranking video. Orange Mango won, Green Apple Lime was a close second, and nobody in the comments agreed with me. Easiest content I've made all year.
